blocks.text: LUCENA CITY — Capybaras, known as the world’s largest living rodents, can now be seen up close at a wildlife farm in Mendez, Cavite, according to the Department of Environment and Natural Resources (DENR). “The world’s largest living rodent can be seen in Cavite! This excellent swimmer and highly sociable animal can be seen up close at Yoki’s Farm in Mendez, Cavite,” the DENR-Calabarzon said on Friday, Nov. 20.
